about.title: About Nalin Dada
about.subtitle: A long journey of astrology, spiritual practice, traditional knowledge and life guidance
about.description: Dr. Nalin Pandya, lovingly known as Nalin Dada, engages with people on astrology, palmistry, numerology, natural wellness, Nabhi Therapy, mantra-tantra and spiritual life.

overview.title: A blend of knowledge, sadhana and life experience
overview.p1: Nalin Dada's work is not limited to one subject. It includes astrology, palmistry, numerology, Ayurveda and natural wellness, Nabhi Therapy, mantra-tantra, spiritual practices and personal life guidance.
overview.p2: His approach across these areas is simple, conversational and experience-based.
overview.highlight: Sadhana, knowledge and life experience — three important foundations of Nalin Dada's journey.

journey.title: Important milestones shared by Nalin Dada
journey.description: Some important milestones from his spiritual journey, as shared by him.

items.title: An important phase of sadhana at Karnali
items.text: Nalin Dada has shared that in 1981 he was called to a sadhana place associated with Gayatri Sant Shantvanji Maharaj and Dakshinamurti Siddh Temple at Karnali, where he performed many Gayatri anushthans.

items.title: Finding and reviving a sadhana place
items.text: He later came across a place connected with an earlier Pitambara Peeth / Baglamukhi sadhana tradition. He restored the place and revived its sadhana tradition.

items.title: Continued Jap, Sadhana and anushthan
items.text: According to Nalin Dada, Jap, Sadhana and anushthans have continued at this sadhana place for about 35 years.
